title: What is in the place? van and nincs

sections.title: There is, there isn't
sections.content: To say what there is in a place, name the place first, then *van*, then the thing: *A szobában van egy asztal.* To say there is none, use *nincs* and leave out *egy*: *A szobában nincs asztal.* *Nincs* is *nem* and *van* joined into one word, so you do not need *nem* as well.

items.english: There is a kitchen in the flat.
There is a table in the room.
There is no chair in the kitchen.
There is no lamp in the bedroom.
Is there a chair in the living room?

sections.content: After *nincs* the noun comes without *egy*: *nincs szék*. And *van* here means “there is”, not “is a”: to say what something is, use *Ez egy szék*, with no *van*.
